reviews.text: Such lovely staff and a wonderful groom. They really went the extra mile for me and my pup. I was so grateful for all their help 🤍
Great Groomers for my blind deaf Shihtzu and spicy Schnauzer guest!!

Outstanding! We have been customers at Hair  of The Dog for over ten years. They now look after our second dog, Rufus. Rita and her staff are brilliant. Can’t recommend this place enough. They are always busy and rightly so.
Brought my family dog in today - elderly, with some skin issues. Immaculate service and awesome cut.

Have taken my little fluff baby Winnie here for her past few grooms after trying a few different places and I am always very happy with the service and end result of her groom here. The staff are lovely and very helpful. The grooming team are always patient with my girl who has some separation anxiety.
10/10!
Great selection, friendly service, and groomers have done a good job in the past.
My Cocker Spaniel has her first ever groom here. Service was great and she looked beautiful for ages afterwards. I’m booking another groom for later this week.

I’ve brought my cockapoo here three times. The first time, they did a fantastic job — exactly what I asked for (see photo 1). Unfortunately, the second visit didn’t go as well. Despite giving precise instructions, they weren’t followed.

Since the staff are friendly, I decided to give them another chance. This time, I even showed them the photo from the first visit, which they took a photo of, and again gave clear instructions. After two and a half hours, I picked him up — I was in a rush and didn’t check everything properly until later. Sadly, they didn’t follow the instructions or the photo reference again. His moustache was cut in a very messy and unflattering way. (Photo 2)

I didn’t bring it up at the time, and I regret not doing so — but realistically, there wasn’t much they could do to fix it. I’m disappointed, especially because the first groom showed they can do a great job when they follow instructions.

Without a doubt the most skilled and loving dog groomers in North London. They’ve cared for our elderly Bichon Frise and his needs. And our latest bonkers Portuguese Water Dog puppy. The team always give the best advice along the way. Highly recommend.
Amazing staff, beautiful cuts

We had our first grooming today and are extremely happy with both the professional and warm service of the staff, as well as the amazing results. Raffy came home the happiest puppy ever. We will be definitely regular there from now on 😍 …

We love Hair of the Dog for Willow’s groom. You don’t need to book months in advance, they listen to your request and she comes out all beautifully washed and trimmed. Recommend for anyone in the area.
Excellent

Fantastic staff and service. Will definitely be back!
They’re a very nice team but we keep finding cuts on our dogs body and the fail to let us know each time. Quality of the work is ok. The pet shop has great choice of product though!

Great little pet shop & groomers.  I've always found the people there to be genuinely warm and friendly !  I took my pup, Rafiki, there for his first groom and  they were unfailingly patient and reassuring, I collected him an hour or so later looking, smelling and feeling  amazing and evidently happy and well cared for.  The price was very reasonable, especially given the location!
Very positive experience with our WFT Gustav who had a hand strip. Nice and efficient staff. Would recommend!
Very friendly and can always fit us in for a nail clipping
